mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(code))=#{code} AND deleted=FALSE AND id != #{excludedId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET code=#{role.code}, name=#{role.name}, description=#{role.description}, status=#{role.status}, deleted=#{role.deleted}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{role.updatedBy} WHERE id=#{role.id} AND version=#{role.version} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.deleted=FALSE AND p.status='ENABLED' WHERE rp.role_id=#{roleId} AND rp.deleted=FALSE

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.deleted=FALSE AND r.status='ENABLED' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.deleted=FALSE JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.deleted=FALSE AND p.status='ENABLED' WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.role_id=#{roleId} AND ur.deleted=FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role other_ur JOIN sys_role other_r ON other_r.id=other_ur.role_id AND other_r.deleted=FALSE AND other_r.status='ENABLED' JOIN sys_role_permission other_rp ON other_rp.role_id=other_r.id AND other_rp.deleted=FALSE WHERE other_ur.user_id=#{userId} AND other_ur.role_id != #{roleId} AND other_ur.deleted=FALSE AND other_rp.permission_id=p.id )
